item.title: Spijkenisse man accused of sextortion of 20 girls now linked to nearly 60 victims
item.description: The man who was accused of extorting 20 teenage girls with nude images has now been linked to nearly three times as many victims, prosecutors said during a short court hearing.

item.title: Keijzer leaves BBB after being passed over for leadership, will serve as independent
item.description: Mona Keijzer, a member of the Dutch House of Representatives and until Monday the party’s vice premier, is leaving the BBB and will continue as an independent legislator.

item.title: Dutch housing market hits record 75,000 Q4 sales as overbidding falls
item.description: The Dutch housing market cooled in the fourth quarter of 2025, even as nearly 75,000 homes were sold, a quarterly record, according to Huispedia.

item.title: Netherlands residents have less trust in others, especially among lower education levels
item.description: People living in the Netherlands are generally satisfied with their own lives, but their trust in others is declining.

item.title: Dutch-Swiss skier latest Dutch victim of avalanche deaths in Alps
item.description: A 22-year-old Dutch-Swiss man died this weekend after being caught in an avalanche while skiing off-piste in Verbier, Switzerland.

item.title: Jan again the most common name on municipal ballots; Only one woman's name in top 50
item.description: The name Jan is once again the most common on the candidate lists for the upcoming municipal elections, according to an analysis by ANP based on data from the Electoral Council.
